name: 周启明
source: 《猫眼之后》角色圣经 02_characters.md 第 3 节（character_id: zhou_qiming）

identity.en: A forty-two-year-old Chinese man, 185 cm tall and about 85 kg, living in an old apartment block in a second-tier Chinese city in the present day
identity.text: 当代二线城市老公寓的住户，身高 185cm、体重约 85kg，做点小生意，说话慢、站姿稳

face.en: A square face with a broad heavy jaw and flat cheekbones, thick dark eyebrows, a deep vertical frown line between the brows, wide nostrils, a small 2 mm black mole just below his left eye, and close grey stubble over the jaw, chin and upper lip; East Asian features, heavy-lidded eyes, a wide mouth with a thin upper lip
face.text: 方脸、宽下颌，浓眉，眉间一道深竖纹，鼻翼宽，左眼下方一颗 2mm 小黑痣，青灰胡茬；东亚五官，眼皮略厚，嘴唇偏薄

hair.en: A grey-black buzz cut about six millimetres long all over, a receding hairline at the temples, sideburns trimmed square and neat
hair.text: 灰黑寸头，约 6mm，发际线后移，鬓角修齐

build.en: Tall and heavily built, with broad shoulders, a thick chest and back and a short thick neck; square, steady stance. Broad blunt hands, a healed three-centimetre burn scar across the web of his right hand, and a pale worn band of old ring mark on the ring finger of his left hand
build.text: 185cm、约 85kg，肩宽背厚、脖子粗，站姿方正沉稳；手掌宽厚，右手虎口一道 3cm 旧烫伤疤，左手无名指有一圈发白的旧戒痕

skin.en: Weathered, slightly coarse skin with visible pores, a faint flush across the nose and cheeks, a little sun-darkened, with fine lines at the outer corners of the eyes
skin.text: 皮肤粗糙有风吹日晒的痕迹，毛孔可见，鼻翼和脸颊微微泛红，眼角有细纹

backCue.en: The back of his close-cropped head and his thick neck, the plain back panel of the dark navy work jacket, and the ring of brass keys hanging at his right hip
backCue.text: 寸头后脑与粗脖颈、深蓝夹克平整的后背，右胯挂着那串黄铜钥匙

top.en: a heavy dark navy cotton work jacket with two chest pockets, open at the front over a grey polo shirt, the left cuff worn pale and fuzzy at the edge
top.text: 深蓝厚棉工装夹克，两个胸袋，敞开穿在灰 polo 外面，左袖口自然磨白起毛

bottom.en: black straight-leg trousers, a plain dark leather belt and brown leather work boots
bottom.text: 黑色直筒裤、深色皮腰带、棕色工装靴

details.en: the ribbed collar of his grey polo shirt, soft and slightly stretched, with one button left open at the throat
details.text: 灰 polo 的罗纹领口，洗得发软，喉下松着一颗扣

details.en: the left cuff of his dark navy work jacket, worn pale and fuzzy where it rubs against the wrist
details.text: 夹克左袖口，长期摩擦处磨白起毛

details.en: the ring of seven brass keys on a steel split ring, hanging from a worn leather loop at his right hip
details.text: 右胯腰带皮环上挂着的七把黄铜钥匙串

details.en: the healed three-centimetre burn scar across the web of his right hand, flat and slightly paler than the skin around it, long healed
details.text: 右手虎口的 3cm 旧烫伤疤，愈合多年、平整略浅、几乎不凸
